About.title: About {brand}
About.intro: {brand} turns a link or a piece of text into a QR code you can download as PNG, SVG or PDF, with no watermark. A static QR can be made without an account.

kinds.title: Static or dynamic
kinds.staticBody: The content is stored in the image itself. It never expires and does not depend on us, but it cannot be changed once printed.
kinds.dynamicBody: The QR points to a short address of ours, which forwards to your destination. You can change the destination without reprinting and see how many times it was scanned. It needs an account.

plans.title: Plans
plans.body: There are Free, Pro and Premium plans. The limits and features of each, such as custom colours and full analytics, are on the plans page. There are no online payments yet: upgrades are activated manually by our team.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Each scan of a dynamic QR stores the date, the device and where the scan came from. The IP address is stored truncated: for IPv4 the last block becomes 0 (for example 203.0.113.0) and for IPv6 only the /48 prefix is kept. We do not keep the full IP.
privacy.retentionBody: Scans older than the history of the QR owner's plan are deleted automatically, every day.
privacy.retentionUnknown: Each plan's period is on the plans page.
